jobs.title: GP Strategic Capital, Value Creation Group - Analyst
jobs.description:
Blue Owl (NYSE: OWL) is a leading asset manager that is redefining alternatives®.

With over $319 billion in assets under management as of June 30, 2026, we invest across three multi-strategy platforms: Credit, Real Assets and GP Strategic Capital. Anchored by a strong permanent capital base, we provide businesses with private capital solutions to drive long-term growth and offer institutional investors, individual investors, and insurance companies differentiated alternative investment opportunities that aim to deliver strong performance, risk-adjusted returns, and capital preservation.

Together with over 1,380 experienced professionals globally, Blue Owl brings the vision and discipline to create the exceptional. To learn more, visit  www.blueowl.com

This role is in office Monday to Thursday

The Role:
Blue Owl GP Strategic Capital purchases minority equity stakes in alternative asset managers across private equity, private credit, real estate, and infrastructure. The GP Stakes Value Creation Group (“VCG”) is its dedicated post-investment team, providing strategic advisory services to these partner firms to help them achieve their goals. VCG works with partner firms on initiatives including fundraising and client development, business strategy and growth, and digital transformation and optimization.

Through this two-year rotational program, the Analyst will gain hands-on experience across VCG’s pillars, working closely with senior VCG leaders on partner consulting engagements. The Analyst will conduct research and analysis and develop recommendations to address partner firms’ strategic priorities.

Responsibilities:
- Collaborate with VCG pillars on strategic initiatives that help leading alternative asset managers grow and strengthen their businesses, spanning client development and marketing, corporate strategy and M&A, human capital, ESG and business resilience, operations and IT, AI, data science, procurement, and private wealth.
- Conduct peer benchmarking, investor mapping, operational assessments, and thematic research to inform partner firms’ strategic priorities.
- Analyze large industry and portfolio datasets to identify trends, uncover opportunities, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
- Develop financial and strategic analyses in Excel and create PowerPoint presentations, including business plans, marketing materials, and recommendations for partner firms.
- Build proprietary playbooks across VCG pillars to share insights and best practices with partner firms.
- Contribute research, analytics, and graphics to whitepapers, newsletters, and other industry thought leadership.
- Track partner engagement activity, maintain CRM records, research service providers, and develop internal resources.
- Manage multiple workstreams across partner engagements and special projects, coordinating with senior team members and external stakeholders to meet deadlines.

Qualifications:
- Undergraduate degree with strong academic credentials and 1–2 years of experience in investment banking, asset management, management consulting, or a related field.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with advanced Excel proficiency and the ability to translate complex information into clear, compelling PowerPoint presentations.
- Demonstrated AI knowledge and interest to continually improve processes and productivity using AI tools
- Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to prioritize competing deadlines and manage multiple projects.
- Self-starter who takes ownership, demonstrates initiative, and exercises sound judgment.
- Intellectual curiosity about private markets.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with senior leaders and external stakeholders.
- Collaborative team player eager to learn and contribute across a broad range of projects and business functions.

It is expected that the base annual salary range for this New York City-based position will be 95,000 to 105,000. Actual salaries may vary based on factors, such as skill, experience, and qualification for the role. Employees may be eligible for a discretionary bonus, based on factors such as individual and team performance.

Benefits for this role include Health, Dental and Vision insurance, 401(k), Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account, Short Term Disability insurance, Long Term Disability Insurance, Family Planning Support, Paid Time Off, and Leave of Absences. All such benefits are subject to the terms/conditions of the Company’s benefits plans and policies.

Blue Owl is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, and other statuses protected by law.

Blue Owl is seeking an Investment Professional to join the Blue Owl Technology Solutions team. Blue Owl Technology Solutions invests in growth stage private technology companies through hybrid, debt and equity capital, as well as AI GPU and datacenter financings. Blue Owl currently has over $315 billion of AUM and is comprised of a team of seasoned investment professionals with significant and diverse experience from some of the world’s leading investment firms and financial institutions.

We seek to provide our investors with attractive risk-adjusted returns by originating, executing, and managing investments in growth-oriented technology businesses that have demonstrated product-market fit and meaningful revenue traction. - Participate in deal team discussions and presentations with investment committee

- Aid in deal origination through market research, targeted thesis building, and direct outreach to companies and earlier stage investors

- Liaise directly with management teams and third party due diligence providers during deal origination and underwriting process

- Participate in the transaction closing, which includes legal documentation and funding operations

- Perform ongoing due diligence and monitoring of portfolio companies; communicate updates to the investment committee (orally and written)

Qualifications :
- Demonstrated 1-3 years of experience in investing, investment banking, and/or consulting. Prior experience with growth-stage hybrid capital, debt or equity investing is a plus but not required

- Strong financial modeling, research and analytical skills with strong proficiency in Excel and Powerpoint

- Leverage AI as a tool to drive efficiency

- Genuine passion for the intersection of technology, business models & strategy, and investing

- Strong interpersonal skills, maturity, and communication capabilities; ability to connect, establish credibility, and build lasting relationships with company founders, CEOs, and outside investors

- Ability to multi-task and balance several workstreams concurrently

- Desire and willingness to work in Menlo Park office approximately four days a week and travel as needed

Blue Owl Insurance Solutions (BOIS) is Blue Owl’s insurance-focused asset management business, partnering with insurance companies to deliver customized investment solutions across private credit, asset-based finance, real estate, and other alternative asset classes. BOIS leverages Blue Owl’s global platform, origination capabilities, and investment expertise to help insurers achieve their return, capital, and liability management objectives. BOIS serves nearly 100 insurance clients and manages more than $30 billion of insurance-related assets. Blue Owl seeks an Associate-level professional in its New York office to join the Strategic Investment team. The Strategic Investment team supports the activities of BOIS across strategic partnerships & investments, asset structuring, and capital markets activities. This role represents a unique opportunity to work across multiple strategic, transaction driven, elements of the insurance ecosystem focusing both on equity style investing and asset origination & structuring.

Responsibilities:
- Support the evaluation, diligence, negotiation, and execution of strategic transactions with insurance companies, including M&A, minority equity investments, reinsurance transactions, investment management agreements, and bespoke capital solutions

- Underwrite equity investments in specialty finance and origination platforms that generate attractive assets for insurance companies, including analysis of origination volumes, unit economics, asset quality, funding structures, and forward-flow arrangements

- Assist in the evaluation, acquisition, and structuring of asset portfolios to meet insurance company objectives

- Support the structuring of investment solutions tailored to insurance company objectives, including rated feeder structures, collateralized fund obligations, and other capital-efficient formats across Blue Owl's credit, asset-based finance, and real estate strategies

- Build and maintain financial models, including transaction models, insurer capital analysis, rating agency capital frameworks, and relative value analysis

- Conduct due diligence on counterparties and targets, including review of financial filings, actuarial reports, investment portfolios, and regulatory considerations

- Prepare investment committee memoranda, board materials, and client presentations

- Coordinate transaction execution across internal origination teams, legal counsel, rating agencies, and external advisors

- Monitor existing strategic partnerships and portfolio investments, including ongoing financial and capital reporting

- Track insurance industry trends, competitor platform activity, and regulatory developments affecting insurer investment behavior

- Support BOIS strategic development including preparation of internal and external materials

Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree required

- 2+ years of experience in investment banking (FIG, M&A or capital markets / structuring backgrounds preferred), insurance corporate development, actuarial advisory, asset based finance (investing or structuring), or a comparable role at an alternative asset manager with an insurance solutions platform

- Strong financial modeling and analytical skills; experience with insurance company financial statements (GAAP and statutory) preferred

- Leverage AI as a tool to drive efficiency.

- Experience with insurance, reinsurance, or broader FIG strongly preferred (i.e., accounting, capital frameworks, investment structuring, rating agency considerations).

- Exposure to structured credit, securitization, or fund finance a plus

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to produce investment-committee-quality materials with limited oversight

- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams in a lean team environment

- High degree of ownership, intellectual curiosity, and collaboration across teams
